opportunities.title: Main Grants (Research, Development and Analysis Fund)
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Projects must be led by UK‑based organisations or institutions (exceptions possible for overseas hosts with UK‑focused dissemination). Applicants must have a formal employment relationship with the host institution.
opportunities.summary: Funding for research projects that address one or more of Nuffield's five priority questions, aiming to improve lives in the UK. Two application rounds per year (Spring and Autumn).

opportunities.title: Racial Diversity UK Fund
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Encourages applicants from diverse backgrounds, particularly from racially minoritised communities, and partnership applications with such communities. Research must focus on racial diversity within the UK.
opportunities.summary: Supports research on racial diversity, inequalities, discrimination and pathways to racial justice in the UK, with an emphasis on inter‑generational changes and an intersectional approach.
